cohorts.replacement_rule: none; every mechanically valid preregistered start is retained regardless of outcome

execution.warm_start: previous CEM mean shifted by receding_horizon through WorldModelPolicy
execution.candidate_seed_rule: same fixed CEM RNG seed for every start and configuration; each start gets a fresh solver and each configuration/cohort is evaluated in a fresh process
execution.latency: per-start synchronized end-to-end wall clock, including reset, preprocessing, planning, and environment execution; checkpoint/dataset load excluded

planner_qualification.selection_rule: highest tuning success rate, then lowest mean cumulative task cost, then lowest median latency, then lexicographic (population, iterations, elites, horizon, receding_horizon)
planner_qualification.primary_success: PushT termination: norm(goal_state[:4]-state[:4]) < 20 and wrapped block-angle error < pi/9 within 50 environment steps

secondary_metrics.task_cost: sum over executed environment steps of Euclidean norm(goal_state-state); lower is better

later_label_informativeness.binary_outcome_variation: report, but do not fail qualification when success is saturated
later_label_informativeness.continuous_outcome_variation: held-out task-cost standard deviation must be > 0 and at least 3 distinct values at 1e-6 precision

failure_criteria: smoke has a mechanical error, nonfinite metric, invalid action shape, or nondeterministic start ledger
no bounded-grid candidate passes the tuning adequacy screen
selected fixed configuration fails the held-out adequacy screen
checkpoint or dataset identity changes after freezing
